notes.text: Pub. L. 118–272, div. A, title I, § 1103(b), Jan. 4, 2025, 138 Stat. 3000, provided that: “Nothing in the amendments made by subsection (a) [amending this section] shall be construed to affect a feasibility study that was initiated prior to the date of the enactment of this Act [Jan. 4, 2025].”

notes.heading: “Secretary” Defined
notes.text: Secretary means the Secretary of the Army, see section 2 of Pub. L. 113–121, set out as a note under section 2201 of this title.

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than February 1 of each year, the Secretary shall develop and submit to the Committee on Environment and Public Works of the Senate and the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure of the House of Representatives an annual report, to be entitled “Report to Congress on Future Water Resources Development”, that identifies the following:

children.heading: Feasibility reports
children.text: Each feasibility report that meets the criteria established in subsection (c)(1)(A).

children.heading: Proposed feasibility studies
children.text: Any proposed feasibility study submitted to the Secretary by a non-Federal interest pursuant to subsection (b) that meets the criteria established in subsection (c)(1)(A).

children.heading: Proposed modifications
children.text: Any proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study that meets the criteria established in subsection (c)(1)(A) that—
is submitted to the Secretary by a non-Federal interest pursuant to subsection (b); or
is identified by the Secretary for authorization.

children.heading: Programmatic modifications
children.text: Any programmatic modification for an environmental infrastructure assistance program.

children.heading: Publication
children.text: Not later than May 1 of each year, the Secretary shall publish in the Federal Register a notice requesting proposals from non-Federal interests for proposed feasibility studies, proposed modifications to authorized water resources development projects and feasibility studies, and proposed modifications for an environmental infrastructure program to be included in the annual report.

children.heading: Deadline for requests
children.text: The Secretary shall include in each notice required by this subsection a requirement that non-Federal interests submit to the Secretary any proposals described in paragraph (1) by not later than 120 days after the date of publication of the notice in the Federal Register in order for the proposals to be considered for inclusion in the annual report.

children.heading: Notification
children.text: On the date of publication of each notice required by this subsection, the Secretary shall—
make the notice publicly available, including on the Internet; and
provide written notification of the publication to the Committee on Environment and Public Works of the Senate and the Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure of the House of Representatives.

children.heading: Feasibility reports, proposed feasibility studies, and proposed modifications
Criteria for inclusion in report
children.text: The Secretary shall include in the annual report only those feasibility reports, proposed feasibility studies, and proposed modifications to authorized water resources development projects and feasibility studies that—
are related to the missions and authorities of the Corps of Engineers;
require specific congressional authorization, including by an Act of Congress;
have not been congressionally authorized;
have not been included in any previous annual report; and
if authorized, could be carried out by the Corps of Engineers.

children.heading: Description
children.text: The Secretary shall describe in the annual report, to the extent applicable and practicable, for each proposed feasibility study and proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study included in the annual report, the benefits, as described in clause (ii), of each such study or proposed modification (including the water resources development project that is the subject of the proposed feasibility study or the proposed modification to an authorized feasibility study).

children.heading: Benefits
children.text: The benefits (or expected benefits, in the case of a proposed feasibility study) described in this clause are benefits to—
the protection of human life and property;
improvement to transportation;
the national, regional, or local economy;
the environment; or
the national security interests of the United States.

children.heading: Identification of other factors
children.text: The Secretary shall identify in the annual report, to the extent practicable—
for each proposed feasibility study included in the annual report, the non-Federal interest that submitted the proposed feasibility study pursuant to subsection (b); and

for each proposed feasibility study and proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study included in the annual report, whether the non-Federal interest has demonstrated—

that local support exists for the proposed feasibility study or proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study (including the water resources development project that is the subject of the proposed feasibility study or the proposed modification to an authorized feasibility study); and
the financial ability to provide the required non-Federal cost share.

children.heading: Modifications of projects carried out pursuant to continuing authority programs
In general
children.text: With respect to a project being carried out pursuant to a continuing authority program for which a proposed modification is necessary because the project is projected to exceed, in the coming fiscal year, the maximum Federal cost of the project, the Secretary shall include a proposed modification in the annual report if the proposed modification will result in completion of construction the 1 project and the justification for the modification is not the result of a change in the scope of the project.

children.heading: Inclusion
children.text: For each proposed modification included in an annual report under clause (i), the Secretary shall include in the annual report—
a justification of why the modification is necessary;
an estimate of the total cost and timeline required to complete construction of the project; and
an indication of continued support by the non-Federal interest and the financial ability of the non-Federal interest to provide the required cost-share.

children.heading: Definition
children.text: For the purposes of this subparagraph, the term “continuing authority program” means any of—
section 701r of this title;
section 426g of this title;
section 577 of this title;
section 426i of this title;
section 2326 of this title;
section 701s of this title;
section 2330 of this title;
section 701g of this title;
section 2309a of this title; and
section 2289b of this title.

children.heading: Transparency
children.text: The Secretary shall include in the annual report, for each feasibility report, proposed feasibility study, and proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study included under paragraph (1)(A)—
the name of the associated non-Federal interest, including the name of any non-Federal interest that has contributed, or is expected to contribute, a non-Federal share of the cost of—
the feasibility report;
the proposed feasibility study;
the authorized feasibility study for which the modification is proposed; or
construction of—
the water resources development project that is the subject of—
the feasibility report;
the proposed feasibility study; or
the authorized feasibility study for which a modification is proposed; or
the proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project;

a letter or statement of support for the feasibility report, proposed feasibility study, or proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study from each associated non-Federal interest;
the purpose of the feasibility report, proposed feasibility study, or proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study;
an estimate, to the extent practicable, of the Federal, non-Federal, and total costs of—
the proposed modification to an authorized feasibility study; and
construction of—
the water resources development project that is the subject of—
the feasibility report; or
the authorized feasibility study for which a modification is proposed, with respect to the change in costs resulting from such modification; or
the proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project; and
an estimate, to the extent practicable, of the monetary and nonmonetary benefits of—
the water resources development project that is the subject of—
the feasibility report; or
the authorized feasibility study for which a modification is proposed, with respect to the benefits of such modification; or
the proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project.

children.heading: Certification
children.text: The Secretary shall include in the annual report a certification stating that each feasibility report, proposed feasibility study, and proposed modification to an authorized water resources development project or feasibility study included in the annual report meets the criteria established in paragraph (1)(A).

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary shall include in the annual report an appendix listing the proposals submitted under subsection (b) that were not included in the annual report under paragraph (1)(A) and a description of why the Secretary determined that those proposals did not meet the criteria for inclusion under such paragraph.

children.heading: Limitation
children.text: In carrying out the activities described in this section—

the Secretary shall not include proposals in the appendix of the annual report that otherwise meet the criteria for inclusion in the annual report solely on the basis of the Secretary’s determination that the proposal requires legislative changes to an authorized water resources development project, feasibility study, or environmental infrastructure program;

the Secretary shall not include proposals in the appendix of the annual report that otherwise meet the criteria for inclusion in the annual report solely on the basis that the proposals are for the purposes of navigation, flood risk management, ecosystem restoration, or municipal or agricultural water supply; and
the Secretary shall not include proposals in the appendix of the annual report that otherwise meet the criteria for inclusion in the annual report solely on the basis of a policy of the Secretary.

tree.heading: Programmatic modifications in annual report
tree.text: The Secretary shall include in the annual report only proposed modifications for an environmental infrastructure assistance program that have not been included in any previous annual report. For each proposed modification, the Secretary shall include a letter or statement of support for the proposed modification from each associated non-Federal interest, description of assistance provided, and total Federal cost of assistance provided.

tree.heading: Special rule for initial annual report
tree.text: Notwithstanding any other deadlines required by this section, the Secretary shall—

children.text: not later than 60 days after June 10, 2014, publish in the Federal Register a notice required by subsection (b)(1); and

include in such notice a requirement that non-Federal interests submit to the Secretary any proposals described in subsection (b)(1) by not later than 120 days after the date of publication of such notice in the Federal Register in order for such proposals to be considered for inclusion in the first annual report developed by the Secretary under this section.

tree.heading: Publication
tree.text: Upon submission of an annual report to Congress, the Secretary shall make the annual report publicly available, including through publication on the Internet.

tree.heading: Non-Federal interest notification
tree.text: After the publication of the annual report under subsection (f), if the proposal of a non-Federal interest submitted under subsection (b) was included by the Secretary in the appendix under subsection (c)(4), the Secretary shall provide written notification to the non-Federal interest of such inclusion.

tree.heading: Congressional notification
tree.text: Not later than 30 days after the publication of the annual report under subsection (f), for each proposal included in that annual report or appendix, the Secretary shall notify each Member of Congress that represents the State in which that proposal will be located that the proposal was included the annual report or the appendix.

tree.heading: Definitions
tree.text: In this section:

children.heading: Annual report
children.text: The term “annual report” means a report required by subsection (a).

children.heading: In general
children.text: The term “feasibility report” means a final feasibility report developed under section 2282 of this title.

children.heading: Inclusions
children.text: The term “feasibility report” includes—
a report described in section 2215(d)(2) of this title; and
where applicable, any associated report of the Chief of Engineers.

children.heading: Feasibility study
children.text: The term “feasibility study” has the meaning given that term in section 2215 of this title.

children.heading: Non-Federal interest
children.text: The term “non-Federal interest” has the meaning given that term in section 1962d–5b of title 42.

children.heading: Water resources development project
children.text: The term “water resources development project” includes a project under an environmental infrastructure assistance program.
